{{Quote|Stay there, Rogue Leader. We're too badly overmatched. You can't help us.|The captain of the ''[[Orthavan]]'' turning down [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] offer of assistance during the [[Battle of Qat Chrystac]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
An '''unidentified Mon Calamari individual''' served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TLC" /> [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 star cruiser]]<ref name="TLCComic-2" />''[[Orthavan]]''<ref name="TLC" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]<ref name="TLCComic-2" /> at the [[Battle of Qat Chrystac]], fought between elements of the New Republic [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces loyal to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] as part of a wider [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the Republic. During the battle, the ''Orthavan'' sustained heavy fire from two [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="TLC" /> and the captain was injured; however, the presence of a hostile [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="TLCComic-2" /> prevented any retreat to [[hyperspace]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] attempted to help out the beleaguered [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], but the captain turned down the offer. Bel Iblis subsequently utilized a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing starfighters]] to distract the Imperial forces long enough for the ''Orthavan'' to close in on the Imperial Interdictor and force it to break off, thus allowing the Republic units to retreat.<ref name="TLC" />
